PI: Nathalie ZILBERMAN, Dean ROEMMICH, Sarah PURKEY, John GILSON

nQueued.description: # of data blocks queued for this dive

nTries.description: # of tries to get the data block receive status in previous dive

parXstat.description: parse_x_reply status in the last surface session

SBDIstat.description: ATSBD return status in last surface session

SBDsecs.description: time taken in sending last SBD message

Vple.description: pump battery voltage at end of last pump

vac0.description: pcase vacuum before filling oil bladder at surface

vac1.description: pcase vacuum after filling oil bladder at surface

PumpT_Hi.description: total time pumped out, up to the last surface pump

SPRX.description: Surface pressure before reset offset (previous dive)

SPRXL.description: Surface pressure after reset offset (previous dive)

diagP0.description: Pressure scan at start of ascent

diagT0.description: Temperature scan at start of ascent

diagS0.description: Salinity scan at start of ascent

diagP1.description: Shallowest pressure scan on descent (ascent if PROup=1)

diagT1.description: Shallowest temperature scan on descent (ascent if PROup=1)

diagS1.description: Shallowest salinity scan on descent (ascent if PROup=1)

DPavg0.description: Average pressure over 1st half of drift

DTavg0.description: Average temperature over 1st half of drift

DSavg0.description: Average salinity over 1st half of drift

DPavg1.description: Average pressure over 2nd half of drift

DTavg1.description: Average temperature over 2nd half of drift

DSavg1.description: Average salinity over 2nd half of drift

ventTm.description: time that air vent motor ran at 50dbar

ventStat.description: LLD status (air present) before and after the air vent ran (50dbar): 0x0001 Prior, 0x0010 Immed. After, 0x0100 10s After

OPVTStat.description: LLD status (air present) before and after the air vent ran (Other pumps): 0x0001 Prior, 0x0010 Immed. After, 0x0100 10s After

nSent.description: # of Iridium messages sent during the last surfacing

W_Fall.description: last fall velocity in cycle (positive means descent)

ccCOR.description: amount of oil adjustment to hit its target depths

PROup.description: profile mode (1: ascent only, 0 or 2: descent only, 3 both)

DsdWake.description: Sum SBE error count during Descending phase: Failed to wake up correctly

DsdPReq.description: Sum SBE error count during Descending phase: Failed to reply to pressure request

DsdPars.description: Sum SBE error count during Descending phase: Failed to parse SBE reply

DsdCRpy.description: Sum SBE error count during Descending phase: While in CP-mode, SBE failed to send a sufficiently long string

DsdCPrs.description: Sum SBE error count during Descending phase: While in CP-mode, Float could not parse the SBE reply

DrfWake.description: Sum SBE error count during Drift phase: Failed to wake up correctly

DrfPReq.description: Sum SBE error count during Drift phase: Failed to reply to pressure request

DrfPars.description: Sum SBE error count during Drift phase: Failed to parse SBE reply

DrfCRpy.description: Sum SBE error count during Drift phase: While in CP-mode, SBE failed to send a sufficiently long string

DrfCPrs.description: Sum SBE error count during Drift phase: While in CP-mode, Float could not parse the SBE reply

AsdWake.description: Sum SBE error count during Ascending phase: Failed to wake up correctly

AsdPReq.description: Sum SBE error count during Ascending phase: Failed to reply to pressure request

AsdPars.description: Sum SBE error count during Ascending phase: Failed to parse SBE reply

AsdCRpy.description: Sum SBE error count during Ascending phase: While in CP-mode, SBE failed to send a sufficiently long string

AsdCPrs.description: Sum SBE error count during Ascending phase: While in CP-mode, Float could not parse the SBE reply
